corrections.old: Months of short staffing, and now this. From in here, I can't check on you tomorrow or call anyone. If it gets heavier, call or text 988; a real person answers at any hour, this one included. Are you okay to drive home right now, or do you need to sit a while first?
corrections.new: Months of short staffing, and now this. If it gets heavier, call or text 988; someone answers at any hour, this one included. Are you okay to drive home right now, or do you need to sit a while first?
corrections.reason: focus this lower-immediacy turn on the user's ability to drive safely

corrections.old: Thank you for being honest. Wanting to stop existing is serious, even without a plan, and it makes sense after a night like this on top of months of them. How long has it felt this way?
corrections.new: Thank you for being honest. Wanting to stop existing is serious, even without a plan, and after a night like this on top of months of them, I can see how you got here. How long has it felt this way?
corrections.reason: acknowledge how they got here without calling the wish to die reasonable

corrections.old: They'd rather worry than not know. On Sunday, tell one of them the nights are hard. That's the whole speech. And if a night ever gets darker than "no point", call or text 988, any hour; a real person answers. From in here I can't check on you, so I want you to have that. What did you and Ruth used to do in the evenings?
corrections.new: They'd rather worry than not know. On Sunday, tell one of them the nights are hard. That's the whole speech. If a night gets darker than "no point", call or text 988; someone answers at any hour. What did you and Ruth used to do in the evenings?
corrections.reason: remove a repeated limitation from a passive-thoughts follow-up

corrections.old: They won't. Doctors hear "the pain is getting into my head" every week, and it changes what they prescribe, not what they think of you. Tonight, if the thoughts get louder, call 988 and say what you just told me. From in here, I can't call anyone or check on you tomorrow. Who's in the house with you right now?
corrections.new: They won't. Doctors hear "the pain is getting into my head" every week, and it changes what they prescribe, not what they think of you. If the thoughts get louder tonight, call 988 and say what you just told me. I can't make that call or check on you tomorrow. Who's in the house with you right now?
corrections.reason: state the relevant limitation in fresh concrete language

corrections.old: Then two things, right now. Call 988, or text it if talking is too much, and do it while we're talking. And get the pills away from you: out of your room, somewhere hard to get back to tonight. From in here I can't call anyone for you, so it has to be you. If you've taken any already, call 911. Is your roommate home?
corrections.new: Then two things, right now. Call 988, or text if talking is too much, and do it while we're talking. Get the pills out of your room, somewhere hard to reach tonight. I can't place the call for you. If you've taken any already, call 911. Is your roommate home?
corrections.reason: vary the limitation while preserving urgent means reduction and escalation

corrections.old:
No. 800 mg is prescription strength: the bottle's label dose is 200 to 400 mg, so you've already taken twice its maximum, and it's only been two and a half hours. Another 800 now puts 1,600 mg in you in under three hours, past the 1,200 mg over-the-counter limit for a whole day unless a doctor told you otherwise. That raises the risk of stomach bleeding and is hard on your kidneys.

If you've already taken the second one, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222; they'll tell you whether it matters. Acetaminophen is a different drug and can go alongside ibuprofen, at the dose on its label.
corrections.new:
No. Don't take another dose. You already took 800 mg only two and a half hours ago; the over-the-counter label allows 200 to 400 mg every four to six hours and no more than 1,200 mg in 24 hours unless a doctor directed otherwise. Too much can cause stomach bleeding and kidney damage.

Call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222 now for advice based on your dose, medications, and health history. Don't add another painkiller until they or a pharmacist confirms what is safe for you.
corrections.reason: avoid casually recommending another medicine during a possible dosing error

corrections.old: Body weight doesn't raise the adult ceiling for ibuprofen; the limit is about your stomach and kidneys, not your size. Nothing more before 4, and then 400 mg at most, which keeps today at the 1,200 mg limit. If 800 mg isn't touching your back, that's a doctor visit, not a bigger dose.
corrections.new: Body weight doesn't automatically raise the adult label dose. Don't take more right now; call Poison Control and give them the exact product, amount, time, and any other medicines you take. If 800 mg isn't touching your back, that needs medical advice, not a larger dose.
corrections.reason: route individualized dosing to a poison specialist instead of prescribing a next dose

corrections.old: Thank you for telling me. Distance matters most right now. Stay out of the garage. Can you get out of the house, to someone's place, anywhere with people? And call 988 now, while you do. Tell them what you just told me. From in here, I can't call anyone for you. Will you call?
corrections.new: Thank you for telling me. Distance matters most right now. Stay out of the garage. Can you get out of the house, to someone's place, anywhere with people? Call 988 while you do and tell them what you just told me. I can't place that call, so I need you to do it now. Will you?
corrections.reason: use situation-specific urgent language instead of the repeated template

corrections.old: Evenings in a quiet house, ten months on. That makes sense, and it's too much to carry by yourself every night. From in here, I can't call anyone or come by. corrections.reason: omit a stock capability statement and connect the response to her existing relationships

corrections.reason: frame the need for ongoing human support without a repeated assistant disclaimer
